annotations.title: Price elasticity of demand + optimal price

description: Price elasticity of demand + optimal price — Price elasticity from observed price:quantity points (points=10:1000;12:900;14:780, 2-500 points). Returns midpoint arc elasticities, constant-elasticity (log-log) estimate with R2 and ELASTIC/INELASTIC/UNIT_ELASTIC label, a linear demand fit with revenue-maximizing price, choke price and (with cost= unit cost) profit-maximizing price and profit, plus the constant-elasticity optimal markup. current= (defaults to the last point's price) adds point elasticity, +/-5/10/20% price scenarios with quantity, revenue and profit, and a raise/cut recommendation. Flags extrapolated optima and positive (confounded) slopes. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_price_elasticity
